recent_text_gradients: Round 1, baseline: Unmodified cold-start baseline; validation=0.205, delta_vs_input=None, outcome=baseline, promoted=True, GPU seconds=10.2. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 2, feature_construction: Apply checkpointed training-frequency scaling exclusively to history inputs for all four category models. Predictor loading restores the saved weights through the imported model class. GRU, scoring, optimization, splits and training schedule remain unchanged.; validation=0.205, delta_vs_input=0.0, outcome=tied, promoted=False, GPU seconds=10.5. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 2, sequence_interest: Exclude left padding from recurrent computation and restore aligned training states. Shared model loading keeps generated inference consistent; checkpoint shapes and all training settings remain unchanged.; validation=0.2025, delta_vs_input=-0.0025, outcome=regressed, promoted=False, GPU seconds=11.4. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 2, learning_objective: Use masked positive-plus-negative logistic loss for all four category models. Model shapes and predictor behavior remain unchanged.; validation=0.205, delta_vs_input=0.0, outcome=tied, promoted=False, GPU seconds=10.2. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

Round 2, embedding_representation: Apply epsilon-protected row-wise L2 normalization to tied item embeddings across training and inference, with padding embeddings fixed at zero. All four dataset models retain the existing architecture, routing and training configuration.; validation=0.1837, delta_vs_input=-0.0213, outcome=regressed, promoted=False, GPU seconds=10.8. An observation of this exact configuration, not a rule against the whole direction.

candidates.budget_accounting: Parallel group cost is sum(estimated_cost_secs) across the selected candidates.
candidates.code_hint:
COMBINATION JUMP: make a substantive, coordinated change in EACH selected direction. 架构与交互: Coordinate backbone-appropriate blocks (GRU recurrence, NextItNet causal convolution, BERT4Rec masked bidirectional attention, or HSTU gated attention), feed-forward structure, residual paths and jointly trained interaction/scoring formulas such as bilinear compatibility.
联合调参: Jointly tune multiple numeric/categorical hyperparameters of the existing program: embedding/hidden dimensions, backbone depth, attention heads where applicable, convolution kernel size where applicable, feed-forward width, max history length, learning rate, dropout, weight decay, batch size, optimizer choice and scheduler settings. A candidate may change any compatible subset together; explain their coupling.
For a jump, preservation rules apply to UNSELECTED directions. Shared changes must have one owner; do not claim the same edit for multiple directions. Keep observed-history data, registered model family, seed 42, epoch cap 200 and batches per epoch 200 fixed.
Maintain shape, checkpoint and predictor consistency for changes in the selected directions; preserve the registered direction boundaries.
